lines: 「Fuumachin, let me borrow some spending money!」
One thoroughly cold night. The freeloading Young Sakura had come to my room and suddenly bowed her head.
「Wh-What's this, all of a sudden? You do know even I'm just barely scraping by, right?」
「Pretty please, Fuuma-kun! Fuuma-sama! Great God Fuuma!!」
As she put her hands together like she was praying, and bowed her head again, I tentatively asked her,
This was a tricky situation. It wasn't like I couldn't dish it out, but it was no small sum for me, either.
（Having said that, there would be a problem if she were to take on another shady part-time job, right......?）
「But, what do you want so badly that you'd go that far? Paying for stuff in a mobile game, or something?」
「No! It's a “MonBox”! I might be able to get a limited Christmas MonBox!」
「MonBox......? You mean, those things that're popular with children?」
It was a children's franchise that had given rise to a major fad recently.
Originating from a game, it had caught fire in the public consciousness with an anime, and had now become such a huge hit that not a single day went by without you seeing a character from it.

In particular, it seemed that toys modelled after the “Monster Boxes” which appeared in the show (small boxes which summoned cute monsters) were so popular that they sold out all over the place one after another, and had
even made the news for being difficult to obtain.
「They recreate the monster summoning from the anime with state-of-the-art 3D imaging...... Was that right?」
「Yeah, yeah! Plus, the limited edition Christmas ones can summon the exclusive Holly Bat monster!」
「I saw on TV, parents who've been asked for them for Christmas are running around everywhere 'cause they can't get their hands on one.」
「But, guess what! I might be able to get one!」
「I tried calling around everywhere, and by chance, they've got one in stock at a toy store in Maesaki City!」
「They weren't even on the net at all, so it's majorly lucky!」
「They say they'll reserve it for me until tomorrow. So, please!」
Sakura bowed her head while assuming the praying posture again.
Well, unlike this world's proper Sakura-sensei, who taught at Gosha Academy, this was Young Sakura in her student days, who had arrived from an alternate world due to a certain incident.
It wasn't surprising that she was still childis――
（No, even Sakura-sensei would probably be making her eyes light up...... Still, I doubt she would go so far as to try and buy one, though.）
Similarly, I would be lying if I said that I had no interest whatsoever in a rare MonBox.
（Three thousand yen, huh......? Things'll be tight in the short term, but I can expect to see some New Year's money pretty soon.）
「......Good grief. Fine, but make sure you pay it back.」
I took out three thousand yen, what little I had in my wallet, and handed it over.
I had been summoned by Headmistress Asagi. It seemed that there was something she wanted the Independent Commando Unit to investigate.
「――So you see, it's a bit of an odd incident. What do you think, Fuuma-kun?」
「It is one of your good points that you'll tell me when you don't know what you don't know.」
Multiple cases of a strange illness had been breaking out in Maesaki City and its surrounding areas.

It was a disease where, one day, someone would suddenly be stuck staring into space, no longer utter any words, and, before long, stop moving, as though their soul had literally escaped from their body.
Even when shown to a doctor, no abnormalities could be detected, and the cause was unknown.
That was happening only in Maesaki City, and to dozens of people.
It was clearly an abnormal situation, but it wasn't like there were any dead or injured, so the police couldn't act.
So, considering the possibility that it was a supernatural phenomenon, they had made a request to the Taimanin for assistance.
「Shizuru-sensei has gone to Maesaki City ahead of you, and is in the middle of gathering intelligence.」
「Then, I should first link up with her and hear the details, right?」
「Quite so. Sakura, you tag along as an escort, just in case.」
A yellow head suddenly popped out from a bookcase's shadow.
This was the grown-up Igawa Sakura-sensei, the original one to exist in this world.
While on the one hand she taught at Gosha Academy, she was active on the front lines as a Taimanin as well, making masterful use of the “Shadow Escape” ninja arts, which utilized shadows.

（Sakura-sensei'll be a reassuring presence on a mission like this, where there's no telling what will happen......
......Huh?! Wait!）
As per our discussion yesterday, Young Sakura would be off to Maesaki City to receive her toy right about now.
（If by some chance they were to meet......）
「Umm...... Th-This isn't such a big deal that we need to put Sakura-sensei to the trouble of coming along......」
「What's that? You're not making yourself clear. Are you saying you don't want to go with Sakura-sensei?」
Unable to find a good excuse on the spur of the moment, I had ended up allowing Sakura-sensei to go with me.
（There's no choice. Well, unlike Gosha, Maesaki City has loads of people, so I doubt they'll run into each other......）
And so, we, the Independent Commando Unit and Sakura-sensei, immediately went down to Maesaki City.
「It's been kind of a while since we all came to Maesaki like this!」
「The city at Christmastime is pretty exciting, don't you think?」
「Oi, oi, you guys...... This is supposed to be a mission, you know?」
As I was reining in those two, who made their eyes light up due to the city, all of a sudden, my sleeve was tugged from behind.
「Sensei has a liiitle place she wants to stop by, okay?☆ I'll be right back.」
Sakura-sensei whispered discreetly into my ear, with mischievous eyes.
「Even Sakura-sensei...... Where is this “place you want to stop by”?」
「A toy store! I hear a hard-to-find toy's miraculously come in～!」
Somehow, I felt like I'd heard a similar story just recently......
「Oh, you're sharp, huh? I called yesterday, and got them to hold it for me for just one day!」
Thinking about it, they were the same person. It wasn't odd if they took the same action.
（But I didn't think the respectable, grown-up Sakura-sensei would want a toy!）
「What do you mean, too? Could it be that Fuuma-kun did as well?」
「N-No! Anyway, we can't! We're on a mission, after all. Even if you are a teacher, I'm going to have you obey your Commander!」
Despite pouting her mouth, she appeared to have reluctantly accepted that.
To start with, as we had been told by Asagi-sensei, we walked to the place where we would link up with Shizuru-sensei.
While comparing it against a map, I looked around the main street, which was exceptionally crowded with people.
Shizuru-sensei was supposed to be in this area, but......
I looked in the direction that Shikanosuke was pointing, and right there was a certain evil snowman I recognized, calling out to the people walking by.
「Oi?! Aren't you that evil snow spirit that was causing trouble because you were jealous of “normies”?!」
「That's right! Are you still making mischief? Have you learned nothing?!」
When we called out to it, the Snowfiend jumped with a start.
「Relax. We're keeping a close eye on him.」
「We're having him help us sell cakes, as our mascot.」
Akiyama Rinko-senpai and Shinohara Mari appeared, dressed in Santa outfits. They were both students at Gosha.
I took it that, yet again, they were working part-time, selling Christmas cakes. Some tasty-looking ones were lined up behind the pair.
「He's doing a good job for us so far.」
「Thanks to him, children and families have begun stopping to look.」
『(Mumble-mumble)...... These days...... I'm the normie...... Fufu.』
Whether because it was surrounded by beautiful women in Santa costumes, or because it was happy to have been given a purpose, the Snowfiend appeared to be working diligently.
I had a feeling it was a bit too creepy to be a mascot, though.
「Ahh, Fuuma-kun and his friends. I've been waiting.」
And furthermore, appearing from behind the two girls was Shizuru-sensei, dressed in extremely provocative Santa clothes.
「I've been joining in on their part-time job while I gather intelligence, so I won't be suspicious♪」
Sure, she probably wouldn't be suspected, but wasn't she standing out too much in a different way......?
It seemed that Shizuru-sensei and her team had gone around investigating the homes of the people afflicted with the aforementioned illness.
They had looked into whether they had something in common, but there were no real signs of them having been broken into, or had anything stolen.
And the only thing they had found in common were MonBoxes.
「That's a highly popular product, right? It's not unusual for them to all have one.」
「But something about that bothered me, so I tried investigating the toys just in case.」
「When I did, they turned out to be some pretty unbelievable goods.」
「When I tried opening them up, far from stereoscopic devices, they were filled with charms and animal bones and such. A kind of magic apparatus, see?」
「Though I say magical apparatus, it's a very simple one. It traps the soul of a Demon World bug or something, and projects an illusion there.」
「So, a summoning device? They were dangerous toys like that?」
「Of course not. The real ones use proper stereoscopic imaging. In other words, these were counterfeit.」
Certainly, MonBoxes, which were in short supply, were sold for a high price even on the net, and it wouldn't be strange for fake ones to emerge.
「Basically, someone planned to make some quick cash by counterfeiting MonBoxes, but it's not easy to imitate the latest technology.」
「So, they relied on Hellish technology for that. You can make something this basic even if you're not a mage, and it's far lower-cost than machinery.」
「Dear, dear. Even MonBox vendors are turning to demonic powers these days, huh?」
If magical instruments were being used, then it wouldn't be strange if they had some connection to that weird phenomenon.
It looked like it was the right call to have asked the Taimanin to investigate.
「If that's the case, then I'd want to investigate the business selling those fakes.」
「I know, right? But there are no clues at all.」
「I've tried searching for receipts in the victims' homes, and getting in contact with shipping companies, but there are no leads.」
（If there's no sign of a shipping agent, then is it a store sale? Shall we try getting in touch with every toy store in the Maesaki area......?）
Sakura's words suddenly came back to mind.
「They weren't even on the net at all, so it's majorly lucky!」
（A Maesaki City toy store that's somehow getting in merchandise so popular that it's sold out, even on the net......）
「Sensei, I might just have an idea.」
I told Shizuru-sensei about the toy store in Maesaki City. Leaving out any mention of Young Sakura, of course.
「I don't know whether the store are the counterfeiters or have just been swindled, though.」
「Sounds pretty worth investigating. Shall we start by targeting that place?」
Like so, our conversation came to a close, and we decided to go to the toy store with Shizuru-sensei.
「We're going to the toy store like you wanted, Sakura-sensei.」
I jokingly called out to Sakura-sensei, who was inside my shadow.
If we were going to be together, then I ought to secretly get in touch with Young Sakura, and ensure they didn't bump into each other.
But, there was no reply from her.
「Sakura-sensei ran off earlier, saying she was going to the bathroom. But she's taking a long time for using the toilet, isn't she......?」
Looking at Hebiko, who cocked her head curiously, a bad feeling suddenly raced through my mind.
（!! Don't tell me...... she secretly went to the toy store? Did she think it was okay to just slip away for a bit while I was exchanging info with Shizuru-sensei?）
No, that was it for sure. I knew, having been living with a Sakura every day.
「Shit. Even after she's become a teacher, Sakura is Sakura, huh?! We've gotta get to the toy store, quickly!」
「You don't have to be so impatient. Heberyone's about to go there now, aren't we?」
「That's true, but...... At any rate, we have to get there quickly, or it'll be dangerous!」
Taking the lead, I started walking to the toy store.
If she had gone on her own, then if the worst happened, I wouldn't even be able to explain it away smoothly.
（We have to avoid them running into each other, at all costs......!）
Two of them from different dimensions.

If they were to meet, then some kind of dangerous, paradoxy, space-time-warpy thing――wasn't that likely to happen, but at the very least, I wouldn't be able to avoid being singled out for punishment by the Gosha Council.
With the voices of Hebiko and the others behind me, I headed to the toy store at a brisk pace.
Meanwhile, at about that time. In a little toy store on a Maesaki City back street.
「What do you mean?! I asked you to hold it for Igawa Sakura-sama, right?!」
Sakura-sensei was advancing on an employee with a stern expression.
Despite being a toy store, there weren't any other toys lined up, as one might expect.
If anything, it was a suspicious-looking interior for one, with the air of a small office.
「I-I said, this “Igawa Sakura-sama” just came to collect it earlier, didn't you?!」
「I don't know what you're talking about! I already told you, this is the first time I've come here～!」
「It's no use lying to try and buy two of them! Even if you change your clothes and make yourself a bit more grown-up, you can't fool me, y'know?!」
Thinking that the two 『Igawa Sakuras』 who had called for a reservation were the same person, the store had put only one aside.
And the one who had come to pick it up first was Young Sakura.
However, after that, the grown-up 『Igawa Sakura』 had come along this time, and flown into a rage when she was told that they didn't have the goods.
From the store's perspective, the situation was, 「A customer who just came by earlier has come again, and is complaining that she hasn't received the merchandise.」
However, having no way of knowing about the existence of another her, in Sakura-sensei's eyes, it was natural for her to get angry that they had reneged on what they promised.
「So, I take it you accidentally sold it, and are trying to cover that up, huh?! Ah, or...?」
「Was it that you didn't really have any stock from the beginning, and were lying to attract customers or something?!」
「Then hurry up and bring out the MonBox already!!」
In the middle of a standoff where both sides wouldn't give an inch, the shop's door opened with a clatter.
「This is the place, huh? Doesn't seem like a shop, though...... Ah, Sakura-sensei!」

Looking like she had forgotten that she had snuck off in secret, Sakura-sensei tried to complain to me about the situation.
――But, before she could,
Shizuru-sensei reined her in by calling her 「Customer-san」 in an unusually stern voice.
Sakura-sensei was blinking her big eyes, with a face that said she didn't understand.
Shizuru-sensei stared firmly at her, with a gaze that was stronger than her tone of voice. As though trying to communicate something with that look.
As you'd expect from a Gosha Taimanin, Sakura-sensei looked to have immediately discerned her aim somehow.
「Sh-Shut up! If this doesn't concern you, then be quiet!」
She promptly put her facial expression back the way it was, and went along with Shizuru-sensei's skit. A little theatrically, though.
Seeing Sakura-sensei like that, Shizuru-sensei also smirked a little, and continued her acting.
「But it does concern me. It'll be a problem for us if you hinder our business, after all.」
Shizuru-sensei gracefully passed by Sakura-sensei, and then began speaking cheerfully to the salesman.
「! O-Onee-san, are you here from the boss?」
The employee looked at Shizuru-sensei with imploring eyes. It appeared he was at a complete loss due to Sakura-sensei's complaint (?).
「Indeed I am. How are things going?」
The employee seemed to trust Shizuru-sensei implicitly, due to the fact that he had been helped out of a tough spot.
He began to talk on and on, making a face like that of a puppy dog that had been saved from drowning.
「The “slave units” are selling great, and raking in cash! And the souls consumed by the slaves are building up nicely in the “master unit”!」
「And once we sell it off to those guys who eat human souls, we'll be able to live comfortably for years. That's one of the boss's ideas for ya, heh heh......」
We all looked at each other due to that outrageous information, but she nodded as though she already knew that.
「Well done. And where is the “master unit”?」
The employee opened a locked shelf, then took out one MonBox that wasn't in its packaging, and placed it gingerly on the desk.
「Good work. Then, I'll be taking this, all right?」
Shizuru-sensei casually stepped closer, and lifted up the box that had been called the “master unit”.

She had not only made use of Sakura-sensei's self-serving actions to ingeniously win the employee over, and successfully extract information from him, but even secured a piece of evidence without a fight.
（We wouldn't be Taimanin if we only battled, would we?）
（Or, should I actually say, getting results without a fight is what's expected of shinobi.）
There were lots of combat-oriented Taimanin in Gosha, so they tended to draw the eye a lot, though.
（Thinking of it like that, maybe there's a lot of stuff even I can do.）
......I was admiring Shizuru-sensei's skillfulness like that, when
「Oh! It's goin' well, I guess, huh?」
The door was swung open, and a loutish-looking man with the air of a gang member came in, accompanied by several underlings.
「I figured it was about time the “master unit” would be full, so I came to pick it up...... Oh?」
When the man noticed our presence, he straightened his posture just a little. He probably thought we were customers.
「Ah! Boss! If it's the “master” you want, I just left it with that lady!」
「Mmm? Lady? Who? There's no women in our organization, ya know?」
「Eh......? But, that lady in Santa clothes over there......」
The men's gazes simultaneously fell upon Shizuru, who held the box in her arms.
「......Dear, dear. And I was so close♪」
Due to this, even Shizuru-sensei stopped acting and took the offensive.
（All the same, fighting's a necessity too, huh?!）
Tension ran through the store. I made eye signals to Hebiko and Shikanosuke, and took a combat stance.
「Come now, you were chattering nonstop, weren't you? In any case, I don't want to be told that by someone who's been tricking people to palm off counterfeit items.」
「The authorities?! Or a competitor?! You got tricked by some troublesome guys!」

「You said “master unit”, right? From what you said earlier, it's something like, you've rigged up the “slave units” you've been selling to suck up their owners' souls, and transfer them to this one, right?」
「Yeah, that's it exactly! We're sellin' premium stuff. We gotta collect a suitable fee for that, don't we?」
「That said, if we did it right away, we'd get caught. So we make sure to collect our “fee” after they use it a few times, see?」
「What's with that?!! That's a horrible business, that even the king of the underworld would be shocked by!!」
Even Sakura-sensei was laying bare her anger. Somehow, I got the feeling that a personal grudge was showing through, though.
「Anyway, now that you've found out, I can't let ya go back alive. Hand over the box and drop dead!!!」
The boss attacked Shizuru-sensei, trying to grab the MonBox by force.
However, she was a Taimanin. She wouldn't succumb to the strength of an ordinary man.
Due to her unexpected strength, the boss's hands slipped, and ended up pulling only the top of the box towards himself――
The box split in two, right from the middle, and from it, monsters resembling bats forcefully flew out.
「That limited edition Christmas monster...... Was it a Holly Bat?」
The Holly Bats were flapping around their box.
「Kyaa?! These boys may be cute, but they're aggressive!」
When we approached them to try and take the MonBox, the Holly Bats snapped at us, and we couldn't even touch it.
However, it looked like that went for the yakuza guys as well.
They were attempting to shoo and swat the Holly Bats, trying to somehow get closer to the box, but they couldn't hit them at all.
「Don't let 'em take our cash cow! Now that it's come to this, we'll nab these guys too, and pawn 'em off in the underworld's year-end sales rush!」
Shizuru-sensei didn't flinch one bit towards the boss, who readied his gun.
「Go ahead and try it, if you can.」
「I can't forgive you for cheating good children right before Christmas.」
「Taimanin Santa the Flower will punish you all!」
